bullets.text: FOMC hiked 25bp to 3.75-4% on a hawkish 16-2 vote; GS scraps one-and-done and adds an October hike.
bullets.source: Goldman Sachs - Fed hike: More hawkish than GS expected; Hawkish Dots Show Two-Hike Baseline; Adding an October Hike

bullets.text: Elara pulls its RBI hike call forward to October 2026 from Feb 2027 and lifts the cycle to a cumulative 75bp.
bullets.source: Elara - Economics: Fed's rate hike today to seal RBI's October policy hike

bullets.text: Post-Fed the 10Y sits at 5.02%, dollar +70bp, WTI -3.2% to $102.43; global metals sold off, VALE -2.3%, RIO -1.5%.
bullets.source: J.P. Morgan - Overnight Brief 9/17: Expect higher yields and equities to coexist

bullets.text: Ambit prefers Hindalco over Vedanta Aluminium in base metals, staying cautious as Fed tightening pressures the complex.
bullets.source: Ambit - Metals Monthly Chartbook: Macro tightens, China weakens

bullets.text: Vedanta's board meets 18 Sep to consider an NCD raise - a leverage watch item on the holdco leg.
bullets.source: Kotak - Basic materials: daily news and prices

bullets.text: Hindustan Zinc cut its domestic zinc benchmark despite a firm LME - a realisation headwind against global strength.
bullets.source: Kotak - Basic materials: daily news and prices

bullets.text: Coking coal imports up 20-50% YoY at JSW, Tata and SAIL with FY27TD prices +19% - an industry-wide cost headwind.
bullets.source: J.P. Morgan - India Daily: Coal: Imports of coking coal surging

bullets.text: HRC +6.2% WoW and the HRC-patra spread +31% to Rs14,757/t, a 3-month high - squeezes APL Apollo's conversion margin.
bullets.source: Nuvama - HRC-Patra spread widens sharply by 31% WoW to INR 14,757/ton

bullets.text: India crude steel output -1.8% MoM in August and finished-steel consumption -0.5% - soft domestic demand backdrop.
bullets.source: Kotak - Basic materials: daily news and prices

bullets.text: Surprise South hike of Rs10-25/bag on stable demand - Dalmia is the most South-levered of the four scored names.
bullets.source: J.P. Morgan - Concrete Insights September: Surprise price hikes in the South; demand still mixed

bullets.text: North cut Rs5-10/bag despite the strongest regional demand and East stayed flat on the weakest - both drag on Shree.
bullets.source: J.P. Morgan - Concrete Insights September: Surprise price hikes in the South; demand still mixed

bullets.text: JPM makes UltraTech its top pick and expects a rebound from late November on festive demand and pricing.
bullets.source: J.P. Morgan - Concrete Insights September: Surprise price hikes in the South; demand still mixed

bullets.text: Indonesian export cuts and China supply curbs have thermal coal +50-60% YTD - a tailwind to Coal India e-auction realisations.
bullets.source: J.P. Morgan - Transition Talks: Coal-ity check: supply shocks, cost pass-through, and transition tension

bullets.text: Seaborne iron ore holds near $100/t on cost-curve support despite weak China steel - eases pressure on NMDC circulars.
bullets.source: J.P. Morgan - Iron ore: Benchmark prices remain steady, while freight rates spike; Simandou ramps up

bullets.text: CLSA reiterates Underperform on Dixon - demand, premiumisation and competition all weighing on the outlook together.
bullets.source: CLSA - Dixon (DIXON IN): Fighting on three fronts

bullets.text: India SEMICON runs 17-19 Sep; watch Kaynes on OSAT scale-up and Syrma on chips packaging for announcements.
bullets.source: J.P. Morgan - India Daily: EMS: India SEMICON preview

bullets.text: Dixon targets 20-25% IT-hardware share of a Rs200-250bn pool plus 120-130bps margin gain; Syrma guides export mix to 33%.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley - India Industrials & Utilities: Virtual Seminar Day Two

bullets.text: MS reads Coforge's board resignations as an individual succession and disclosure issue, not board-wide; NRC chair seated.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley - India Trends & Themes: UPI MDR Framework Revised; Coforge Board Resignations in Focus

bullets.text: Coforge has engaged Egon Zehnder for board hires - active replacement rather than a prolonged vacancy.
bullets.source: Kotak - Technology News Wrap, September 16

bullets.text: Tech Mahindra will channel recent margin gains into growth investment over its next three-year plan, not further margin.
bullets.source: Kotak - Technology News Wrap, September 16

ai_semis.text: SOX closed +0.63% while the S&P fell 0.45% - semis held in as the broad tape sold the Fed hike.
AMD +1.65% and TSMC ADR +0.96% led; Broadcom was flat at +0.07% despite guiding AI revenue to $230bn by 2030.
Over a quarter of Nvidia revenue now comes from customers based outside its core hyperscaler set.
ai_semis.source: Motley Fool - More Than a Quarter of Nvidia's Revenue Now Comes From Customers Based Abroad

bellwethers.name: Accenture
bellwethers.reason: Investor fears of AI disintermediation weighed on the stock; a $25m DOJ discrimination settlement was also in the tape.
